title: Header action shows it is already pressed: page:header and DeclaredActionsBar read action.pressed
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the ui half of #27946, whose contract half lands in PR #28235 (claim 6528706898, surface amendment 6528737693; carried to the seat by os-dev-report 6530445276). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any record page header action the reader toggles. HotCRM `mark_article_helpful` / `mark_article_not_helpful` on a knowledge article cannot tell the reader they already voted.

## Observed (once PR #28235 is on `main`)

- `ActionSchema.pressed` is declared: an evaluated expression (no boolean arm) over `record` and `user`, judged by lint in record scope; `action pressed` is a served-row site, so an `attachedOnRead` block reads in it.
- Liveness `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` `pressed` is `planned` with an author warning; the expression ledger row `cel-action-pressed` is `experimental`; `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` lists the key inventory-only, `ActionDef` does not derive it.

## Wanted

- `page:header` buttons and `DeclaredActionsBar` evaluate `action.pressed` per record and draw `aria-pressed` with a pressed face. Test plus ablation.
- `ActionDef` derives the key (drop the inventory-only comment in `actionKeys.ts`).
- In the same PR, re-state together: liveness `pressed` `planned` → `live` (drop `authorWarn` / `authorHint`), and the ledger `cel-action-pressed` → enforced with its fail face (contract review should-fix on #28235). Remove the "not yet drawn" callout in `actions.mdx`.

Dedupe words: action pressed state, aria-pressed header action, toggle action active.

Links back: #27946, PR #28235.

Blocked-by: #28235
